author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Scherzer to make two more rehab starts in Triple-A
desc: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said Max Scherzer will make at least two more rehab starts in Triple-A.
impact: Schneider said that Scherzer "felt good" after his rehab start on Friday. He will have a chance to be activated by the end of July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: George Springer day-to-day on paternity list
desc: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said George Springer remains day-to-day on the paternity list.
impact: Springer could be activated this weekend against the Mariners.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jesus Sanchez (ankle) resumes running, hitting
desc: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said Jesus Sanchez resumed running and hitting on Friday.
impact: Sanchez is rehabbing in Florida. There should be an update on his status following the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Addison Barger (back) rehabbing through All-Star break
desc: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said Addison Barger is rehabbing through the All-Star break.
impact: Barger remains in Florida rehabbing. There should be an update on him later in July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Campusano (toe) activated from IL
desc: The Padres activated Luis Campusano from the injured list.
impact: Campusano makes his return with Freddy Fermin placed on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Freddy Fermin (head) placed on concussion IL
desc: The Padres placed Freddy Fermin on the injured list with a head bruise.
impact: It is not a concussion for Fermin. He will be sidelined through the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Alek Jacob recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Padres recalled Alek Jacob from Triple-A El Paso.
impact: Jacob will add an extra arm in the bullpen for San Diego with Randy Vasquez placed on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Randy Vasquez (ankle) placed on IL
desc: The Padres placed Randy Vasquez on the 15-day injured list with a right ankle bruise.
impact: Vasquez will be sidelined at least the next few weeks through the All-Star break. Alek Jacob gets recalled as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Will Smith (neck) resumes throwing, hitting
desc: Will Smith resumed throwing and has been hitting in the batting cages.
impact: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts told reporters the update. Smith remains on track to return after the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: John Brebbia elects free agency
desc: John Brebbia has elected free agency.
impact: Brebbia was designated for assignment by the Rockies earlier in the week. He will explore free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Stuart Fairchild sent outright by Guardians
desc: The Guardians sent OF Stuart Fairchild outright to Triple-A Columbus.
impact: Fairchild was designated for assignment last weekend and passed through waivers unclaimed. He will remain in the Guardians organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Joe Ross re-signs with Rangers on minor league deal
desc: The Rangers re-signed RHP Joe Ross to a minor league contract.
impact: Ross returns to the Rangers organization after exploring free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sam Huff re-signs with Orioles on minor league deal
desc: The Orioles re-signed C Sam Huff to a minor league contract.
impact: Huff returns to Baltimore after exploring free agency.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chandler Simpson scratched Friday with finger injury
desc: Rays manager Kevin Cash said Chandler Simpson was scratched due to sore right index and middle fingers he jammed sliding into second base in Thursday's game.
impact: It is a precautionary move. Simpson is considered day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Victor Robles (forearm) in lineup Friday
desc: Victor Robles is in the Mariners lineup on Friday against the Blue Jays.
impact: Robles is good to go after leaving Thursday's game early after he was hit by a pitch. He is in center field and batting eighth.
